findings.title: Resolve a new image before treating a rerun as an upgrade
findings.explanation: After installing with the documented default image, rerunning the same command after a new Fleet Manager image is published leaves image_uri/image at docker.io/quesma/fleet-manager:latest. With otherwise unchanged Terraform configuration, apply has no service change to make and does not roll out the new image. The script nevertheless reports success and explicitly tells operators that this command upgrades, leaving their fleet on the old service version.
findings.evidence: The new script fetches only Terraform source, then calls init and apply; it neither resolves an image digest nor requests a service rollout. Both snapshots templates use a literal :latest default (AWS primary_container.image = var.image_uri, GCP containers.image = var.image). The base had no deploy.sh; the new automatic upgrade path exposes this existing template behavior. This conclusion is from source tracing, not a live deployment.
findings.fix: Resolve the intended published image to an immutable digest/tag and persist it before apply, or explicitly trigger a rollout; make the documented rerun behavior match the implementation.

findings.title: Allow an explicitly empty telemetry URL to disable forwarding
findings.explanation: Once an operator has deployed with --telemetry https://collector.example.com, running again with --telemetry "" cannot turn forwarding off. collect_vars treats the explicit empty value as an omitted flag and reloads the old collector from terraform.tfvars.json. The apply succeeds with the previous URL, continuing to forward telemetry for organizations that use the deployment default.
findings.evidence: Ran the head script main function in a temporary directory with Terraform, preflight, fetch, and health functions replaced by safe local stubs. Seeded a saved collector and passed gcp --telemetry "" --yes. The command exited 0 and the rewritten JSON retained https://collector.example.com. The base has no deploy.sh; its Terraform variable explicitly uses an empty URL for disabled forwarding.
findings.fix: Track whether --telemetry was supplied separately from its string value, and honor an explicit empty value (or provide a documented --no-telemetry option).
